'''Jabe Calwell''' was the son of [[Dannar Calwell|Dannar]] and [[Annileen Calwell]], two [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|Merchants]] of the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]]. He was also the brother of [[Kallie Calwell]].
